items.title: Why Is Apple (AAPL) Capping Internal AI Spending Under John Ternus?
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) has introduced strict internal limits on AI spending and usage under new CEO John Ternus. The new rules cap internal AI project budgets and headcount allocations in response to rising expenses and margin pressure. Teams working on AI tooling for employees must now justify infrastructure usage with tighter approval thresholds and periodic cost reviews. Apple's new AI usage and budget caps fit into a broader pattern of internal shifts that recent research has highlighted...
